description: TikTok’s OWN first-party trending hashtags, through the TikTok Ads connection: kind "hashtags" lists the top hashtags by country, industry category (e.g. FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE, BEAUTY_AND_PERSONAL_CARE, TECHNOLOGY, or ALL) and period (1DAY/7DAY/30DAY/120DAY) with rank, rank change, views, posts and top countries; "hashtag_detail" gives one hashtag’s 30-day trend and audience ages; "hashtag_videos" gives the top videos using up to 10 hashtags. A detail or video read must use the SAME countryCode and dateRange the hashtag was listed with. Read-only, free.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

hashtagIds.description: for hashtag_detail (first id) and hashtag_videos (up to 10)
